name: Cleveland State University
description: Cleveland State University is a public research institution with 17,000-plus students, 10 colleges and schools and more than 175 academic programs. Engaged Learning connects CSU students with 3,000 co-ops, internships and other experiential learning opportunities with employers in virtually every industry, ensuing they graduate fully prepared to succeed in their chosen professions. Partnering with world-class hospitals, Fortune 500 companies, government research centers, and cultural institutions. To give its students academic, research, and job opportunities including research cooperation agreements with the nearby NASA Glenn Research Center. Timestamps
